📺 Manifest (2018–2023)

Manifest follows the passengers and crew of Montego Air Flight 828, who experience a seemingly normal flight from Jamaica to New York, only to discover that more than five years have mysteriously passed while they were in the air. For everyone on board, no time has passed, but their families and the world have moved on without them. As the passengers struggle to rebuild their lives, they begin experiencing strange visions and mysterious voices known as “callings,” guiding them toward events they cannot explain. Siblings Michaela and Ben Stone become determined to uncover the truth behind the flight while facing dangerous secrets, emotional reunions, and unexpected supernatural discoveries. Filled with suspense, shocking twists, and emotional moments, Manifest explores destiny, faith, family, and the mysteries of life and death.

🎭 Genre: Mystery • Drama • Sci-Fi • Supernatural • Thriller

⭐ IMDb: 7.0/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 42–50 minutes per episode • TV-14

🎥 Creator: Jeff Rake

📺 Where to Watch: Netflix in the United States.

source_details.synopsis: Manifest is an American supernatural drama television series created by Jeff Rake that premiered on September 24, 2018, on NBC. It centers on the passengers and crew on a commercial airliner who suddenly reappear after their plane goes missing and they are presumed dead for five and a half years. It stars Melissa Roxburgh, Josh Dallas, Athena Karkanis, J. R. Ramirez, Luna Blaise, Jack Messina, Parveen Kaur, Matt Long, Holly Taylor, Daryl Edwards, and Ty Doran. In October 2018, NBC ordered further episodes for the first season and subsequently renewed the series for a second season that aired in 2020, and again for a third in 2021.
